root.label: Israeli strike wounds Al-Manar reporter and cameraman in Nabatiyeh

events.label: Israeli strike wounds Al-Manar reporter and cameraman in Nabatiyeh

slots.name: people wounded
slots.sentence: A reporter for Hezbollah-controlled Al-Manar TV and a cameraman were wounded Sunday night when a second Israeli strike hit near them as they were covering an earlier strike in Nabatiyeh city in southern Lebanon.
